files.summary: track whole-request preparation cost and duplicate same-snapshot effect-impact scans under WW11
edits:
- **Whole-request authoring preparation:** qualify cold and reused recipe/status-policy submission, review and Apply with large definition catalogues and affected-effect populations. [CTX02](../limits/inventions.md#ctx02--preparation-and-disclosure-work) records synchronous native validation, full effect-impact enumeration and cold fingerprinting outside the candidate-graph counter. [Approval and Apply](../../apps/server/src/world-authoring.ts) currently compute effect impact, then compute it again through the default argument of `authoringEvidenceDependencies` when checking prepared evidence. Reuse that already-computed impact within the same snapshot before adding a new cache or executor; an awaited mutation or a later approval still requires current impact. Attribute CPU, temporary memory, event-loop delay and database time separately. Preserve exact episode identity and active state, definition changes, subject removal, restore and current authority; neither a small prompt nor a truncated effect list qualifies the full request. This is source-identified repeated work, not a measured latency regression or a reopened finite WW18–WW23 acceptance claim.
